video_title: Stephen A. is ‘very proud’ of what he’s seeing from Mikal Bridges in the NBA Playoffs 👏 | First Take

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Mikal Bridges trade worth is justified if Knicks win championship
quotes.excerpt: If the Knicks get to the Finals and win, it won't matter.

text_blocks.speaker: Shae Cornette
text_blocks.text: Has Bridges proven that he's worthy of all those picks this postseason?

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Well, Shae, I'm laughing because I was standing in the Knicks tunnel after the game the other night and the Knicks, there's a bunch of Knicks fans who had tickets right alongside the Knicks tunnel. And as Bridges was coming off an absolute masterful performance, they were shouting 'bleep them picks!' You know, the old LA Rams thing about when they won the championship. And he tried not to smile, but I know he heard it because there was no way you couldn't hear it. And I think that's been something we've heard a lot in New York in this postseason. Now, let me just say this. As I'm getting older, guys, I'm starting to develop these sayings and I can't help it and I'm not stopping. And one of my things I've learned in the NBA is when you win a championship, it means never saying you're sorry. Whatever it took to get you to that championship, it doesn't matter. It's so hard to win that you never apologize for what it took. And the Knicks may be on the verge of it. And so, I can't answer this question, Shae. First off, I think we should know that so far the picks that have transferred to the Nets have been pick numbers 19 and 26. I don't think the Knicks have any looking back. But I can't see what's going to happen in 2031. In 2031, that might be the greatest player since Jordan that gets drafted with the pick that the Knicks traded. Nobody knows, but this I do know. If the Knicks get to the Finals and win, it won't matter. Because if Mikal Bridges is a piece that you needed to get you to this level, then whatever you had to do makes it worth it. That's a rule of the NBA that I believe and that's a rule that I think should be applied in this case.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. takes credit for Mikal Bridges' improved playoff performance
quotes.excerpt: I go off and they've won 10 straight. Maybe I should do it again.
quotes.quote: Contrary to popular belief, I am a humble soul. And I don't like to toot my own horn, but I'm going to take the opportunity to do just that today. Because a lot of people will look at me and get on me because of how I was going off about Mikal Bridges, including Josh Hart. And I know it's popular to sit up there and say, 'What do you think now, Stephen A.? What do you think now?' And what they don't realize is that I'm looking at them and I'm saying, 'You're welcome.' Because since I went off, Shae, in the nation's capital, and I was sweating bullets, looking like I was about to have a stroke on national television because the New York Knicks had lost to the Atlanta Hawks and I went ballistic talking about you better not lose this series. The Knicks haven't lost a game. They haven't lost a game. So guess what? I go off and they've won 10 straight. I don't know how y'all looking at it, but I know how I'm looking at it. Maybe I should do it again.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. is proud of Mikal Bridges' efficient playoff scoring
quotes.excerpt: I'm very proud of what I'm seeing.
quotes.quote: Because I knew that Mikal Bridges is better than 7.2 points a game on 44% shooting. And over the last eight games of this postseason, he's at 19 on 69% shooting and 48 from three-point range. I'm good with that because you're efficient and you're effective. Shoot 68% over the last 10 games. Shoot 71% over the last three games against Cleveland. I'm looking at this stuff. I'm like, 'Yeah, give me that.' If we give up four unprotected first-round picks for you, plus an additional pick, plus a pick to be swapped, I expect you to go out there and play. You don't have to average 30 a night, but you got to at least be what we're seeing him be in these last 10 games. And I'm very proud of what I'm seeing. So Josh Hart was absolutely right coming to the defense of his teammate as he should. Look at how together they are. Look at how they are playing. It is fabulous to watch.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. doesn't care about Giannis if Knicks win championship
quotes.excerpt: I don't give a damn about Giannis if the Knicks win the chip.
quotes.quote: You haven't won a chip yet. And here's where it comes down to. Why do those picks matter? Windy, it's not about 19 or 26 or anything like that. It's about the fact that you and various others reported over this summer that the Knicks had a chance to get Giannis. And if you have those assets, you could have had Giannis. You know what erases that? You're absolutely right, Windy. It don't, I don't give a damn about Giannis if the Knicks win the chip. Knicks win the chip, I could care less. Finally, after since 1973, a championship is back at the Garden. I'm good. But that's what it takes. They've been to the Finals in '99, then '94. They've been to the title in '99. They came up short. They haven't won a title since 1973. I want the chip. Orange and blue skies. It wasn't '99. This is the best opportunity the New York Knicks have had since 1994.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks have best championship opportunity since 1994
quotes.excerpt: This is the moment we've been waiting for.
quotes.quote: It's been 32 years. This is the best. This is not about Doggy. This is not about, 'Oh my goodness, we got to the Finals.' And then I'm looking at you and the epitaph is already written because there's no way in hell you're going to beat San Antonio, OKC. No. We, the Knicks, got us looking at them going like this, 'Alright, they would be the underdog, but they could pull this off. They might pull this off.' This, this is what I'm talking about. This is the moment we've been waiting for. You close the deal tonight. You go into that Finals. You make sure you scratch, you claw, you fight, and you got a chance to bring the chip back to Madison Square Garden. We good. We good. But that didn't look like it was going to happen at the end of the regular season. It didn't look like it was going to happen after three games against the Atlanta Hawks. I said what I said. I meant every damn syllable that I uttered out of my mouth. You understand? And I'd do it again if it gives us the results that we've gotten since that motivational speech that I was given.

quotes.speaker: Chris Russo
quotes.summary_phrase: Eastern Conference is 'garbage' and Knicks trade value is questionable
quotes.excerpt: Let's take it easy with this 10-game winning streak against the garbage in the Eastern Conference.

text_blocks.speaker: Chris Russo
text_blocks.text: The both of them are 100% right, if they win a championship, nobody cares about the picks. But normally speaking, you don't give up five picks for what is essentially the fourth best player on the team. Because he's not better than OG, he's not better than Towns, and he's not better than obviously Brunson. Normally you wouldn't make that trade, but they win it all, I can't say a word. Here's one thing I'm going to say because I'm getting tired of this now, and Stephen A. especially. The Atlanta Hawks, the Philadelphia 76ers, and the Cleveland Cavaliers, these teams are not good. They are not good teams. The Hawks are not a good, they're okay. They were down 2-1. Philadelphia had their Game 7 against the Celtics when they won that game, Embiid didn't play. Philly's not that good. And Cleveland isn't that good. I mean, let's take it easy with this 10-game winning streak against the garbage in the Eastern Conference. They did not beat the Chicago Bulls with Jordan and Pippen. Let's take it easy, please, Timmy, take it easy. If they go out there to Oklahoma City and get killed, then what are we going to say about the Eastern Conference? You're hot stuff. You had Detroit in the Final a couple of months ago for crying out loud. I can't listen to you. You love the Pistons. I didn't have the Pistons. I didn't have them. But let's take it easy on this Eastern Conference. You guys are going crazy. Brian, your thoughts on the East. It's lousy. Call it like we see it. No.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: I've seen better. I've seen worse. I'll, I'll, I will say this one thing, Dog. They may have caught the 76ers satisfied and they may have caught the Cavs satisfied, but the Knicks have been unsatisfied and they should get credit for that.
